# <Feature> design

Status: Proposed or Current — identify scope and known gaps.
Product authority: Link the feature specification and relevant acceptance IDs.

## Responsibilities and boundaries

Name components, data ownership, interfaces and dependencies. Link schema/code rather than duplicating their field catalogues.

## State and failures

Describe meaningful transitions, concurrent writes, partial failure, retry and recovery. State what is and is not atomic. Add migration/rollback details when needed.

## Verification

Link tests and manual checks to the product acceptance criteria; record remaining discrepancies.

## Decisions

Link accepted ADRs for durable trade-offs. Keep unresolved alternatives in a proposal. Remove unused headings; do not describe every function.
